posts.name: ishitadarade
posts.cooked: I have opted for repeat OPPE only , for System commands this term. Do I still need to do the assignments and the BPTs? Kindly let me know if anyone knows what is to be done

posts.name: Ankit
posts.cooked: Yes, they are required for eligibility, so you’ll need to complete them. Since you’ve done this previously, you won’t have much to do — your previous term’s solution will already be available; you just need to submit it (Synchro Eval). The BPT marks will be carried forward from the previous term and not counted for this one.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: You only need to do BPTs for eligibility purpose. If you are repeat OPPE only, GAs are not required.
